free_tier.stated: Free Forever: 1 DNS zone, 50 DNS records, 500,000 queries per month, 1 mail forward, 1 dynamic DNS hostname, 4 unicast nameservers

per_object_cap.notes: the tightest record cap in this class

retention.stated: a zone with no DNS queries for over 30 days can be deleted without notice, the free plan named in particular

egress.terms: 500,000 DNS queries per month on Free, the only published query cap in this class

interface_detail: the HTTP API at https://api.cloudns.net/ (auth-id and auth-password) manages zones and records, but the plan table marks HTTP API access absent on Free and present from Premium S at $2.95/month; the free plan's programmatic path is the DynURL of its one dynamic hostname, https://ipv4.cloudns.net/api/dynamicURL/?q=<token> (the ipv6.cloudns.net host for an AAAA record)
tooling: on Free, curl or wget against the DynURL from cron, and the wiki's DynURL guides for Windows, Linux, Synology, MikroTik and pfSense; the HTTP API needs a paid plan
chaining: the plan table gives Free no secondary DNS zones and no zone transfers, which rules out an AXFR pairing with another provider but not a second provider whose records are mirrored by hand

limits.value: a zone with no DNS queries for over 30 days can be deleted without notice

identity_cost.detail: a first and last name, an e-mail address, a password and an hCaptcha; no phone and no card on the signup form (https://www.cloudns.net/index/show/signup/); an identity verification can be requested after signup

reliability_note: a zone with no DNS queries for over 30 days, or a Free zone delegated to non-ClouDNS nameservers, can be suspended or deleted without notice
confidence_note: the managed-DNS page was read and states the Free Forever column explicitly.
